description: This Java class defines a collection of constants used for the 'Things Search' feature within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes static final String values that specify important paths and identifiers associated with actor paths, cluster roles, and shard regions.

classes.name: ThingsSearchConstants
classes.description: A utility class providing constants for the Things Search feature, including actor paths and cluster role names used in the system.

methods.name: ThingsSearchConstants()
methods.description: Private constructor to prevent instantiation, as this class is intended to be a static utility class.
